173	/** OceanCaves pass(cs:15228):地牢侧海洋 1/3 概率一条;返回宝藏点集(UnderwaterChests 消费) */
174	export function runOceanCavesPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState): Array<{ x: number; y: number }> {
175	  // 一次性探针钩（同 WebsPass 模式）：OceanCaves 入口快照（债时间线用）
176	  const g0 = globalThis as { __swOcCap?: (gs: GenState, st: TileStore) => void };
177	  try { g0.__swOcCap?.(gs, st); } catch { /* probe */ }
178	  const treasures: Array<{ x: number; y: number }> = [];
179	  const { w } = st;
180	  for (const side of [0, 1] as const) {
181	    // 左海洋仅当地牢在左(dungeonSide < Right)、右海洋仅当在右(cs:15243)
182	    if (side === 0 && gs.dungeonSide !== -1) continue;
183	    if (side === 1 && gs.dungeonSide !== 1) continue;
184	    if (rng.int(0, 2) !== 0) continue; // 1/3
185	    // ★cs:15249-15252:`int num = genRand.Next(55, 95); if (i == 1) num = Next(w-95, w-55);`
186	    //   右洋(i==1)的首次 Next(55,95) 被丢弃但**消耗掷骰流**——此前 JS 只掷一次,
187	    //   右洋蠕虫后续全部掷骰错位(8888 种子对拍实锤:HARDSAND/SAND 壳层错写 ~13k 格)。
188	    let x: number;
189	    if (side === 0) x = rng.int(55, 94);
190	    else { rng.int(55, 94); x = rng.int(w - 95, w - 56); }
191	    let j = 0;
192	    while (j < st.h && !activeAt(st, x, j)) j++;
193	    if (j >= st.h) continue;
194	    treasures.push(...oceanCave(st, rng, gs, x, j));
195	  }
196	  return treasures;
197	}

199	/** UnderwaterChests pass 的宝藏点段（cs:17348-17368）1:1：
200	 *  主件 NextFromList [863,186,277,187,4404]；num 自 2.0 起步进 0.1 扩窗重试
201	 *  （<50），采样域 [x±num, y±num/2]（上界 +1 含端），越右界回折 num/2；
202	 *  命中液体 ≥250 且为水 → AddBuriedChest(style17, trySlope:true)。 */
203	export function runUnderwaterChestsPass(
204	  st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink, treasures: Array<{ x: number; y: number }>,
205	): void {
206	  for (const t of treasures) {
207	    const main = [863, 186, 277, 187, 4404][rng.int(0, 4)];        // NextFromList
208	    let num = 2.0;
209	    for (;;) {
210	      if (num >= 50.0) break;
211	      num += 0.1;
212	      let x = rng.int(t.x - Math.floor(num), t.x + Math.floor(num));    // Next(x-num, x+num+1)
213	      const y = rng.int(t.y - Math.floor(num / 2), t.y + Math.floor(num / 2));
214	      // cs:17362：num2 越右界 → 折回 num/2（InWorld 由 placeBuriedChest 自行兜底）
215	      x = x >= st.w ? Math.floor(x + num / 2) : Math.floor(x - num / 2);
216	      if (st.inBounds(x, y)) {
217	        const i = st.idx(x, y);
218	        // liquidType 修 2026-08-12:同 BuriedChestsPass——本仓库 +1 编码,水=LIQUID_TYPE.WATER
219	        // (原 ===0 永假 → 海洋洞窟水中箱特性静默失效)
220	        if (st.liquid[i] > 250 && st.liquidType[i] === LIQUID_TYPE.WATER) {
221	          if (placeBuriedChest(st, rng, gs, chests, x, y, {
222	            style: 17, loot: main, flags: { water: true }, trySlope: true,
223	          })) break;
224	        }
225	      }
226	    }
227	  }
228	}

162:export function runJungleChestsPass(
export function runJungleChestsPass(
  st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink, spots: Array<{ x: number; y: number }>,
): void {
  for (const s of spots) {
    const main = nextJungleItem(gs, rng);
    if (!placeBuriedChest(st, rng, gs, chests, s.x + rng.int(0, 1), s.y, { style: 10, loot: main, flags: { ivy: true } })) {
      for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
        for (let dy = 0; dy <= 2; dy++) {
          if (st.inBounds(s.x + dx, s.y + dy)) st.setTileSilent(s.x + dx, s.y + dy, 0);
        }
      }
      // ★J3(cs:17324-17332):第二次放置前对 3×4(含地面行 y+3)统一 slope(0)/
      //   halfBrick(false)——落地行残留半砖/坡面会顶掉第二次 AddBuriedChest。
      for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
        for (let dy = 0; dy <= 3; dy++) {
          if (!st.inBounds(s.x + dx, s.y + dy)) continue;
          const i = st.idx(s.x + dx, s.y + dy);
          st.slope[i] = 0; st.half[i] = 0;
        }
      }
      placeBuriedChest(st, rng, gs, chests, s.x, s.y, { style: 10, loot: main, flags: { ivy: true } });
    }
  }
}

		CheckExploitDestroyQueue();
	}

	public static void CheckExploitDestroyQueue()
	{
		if (destroyObject)
		{
			return;
		}
		while (ExploitDestroyQueue.Count > 0)
		{
			Point point = ExploitDestroyQueue.Dequeue();
			if (Framing.GetTileSafely(point.X, point.Y).active())
			{
				SquareTileFrame(point.X, point.Y);
				if (Main.netMode != 0)
				{
					NetMessage.SendTileSquare(-1, point.X, point.Y);
				}
			}
		}
	}

 *    四邻 resetFrame=true 在后。 */
export function genFrameNeighbors(
  st: TileStore, rng: RNG,

    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x + 1, y, false);
    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x - 1, y, false);
    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x, y + 1, false);
    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x, y - 1, false);
  } else {
    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x, y, true);
    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x + 1, y, true);
    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x - 1, y, true);
    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x, y + 1, true);
    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x, y - 1, true);
  }
}

/** SquareTileFrame 生成期（cs:80924，九宫、仅中心 resetFrame=true）——
 *  FrameOutAllHiveContents 的 tile 侧等消费端（cs:22544 同构邻格击杀级联） */
export function genSquareTileFrame(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number): void {
  const ctx: SweepCtx = { rng, destroyObject: false, frameSparse: false, stats: undefined };
  squareTileFrame(st, ctx, x, y);
}

/** UUUU 批新增纯导出：WorldGen.TileFrame(i, j, resetFrame:true) 单格生成期入口
 *  （DeadMansChest ActuallyPlace* 族的字面镜像——cs:532/570/617 直调单格 TileFrame
 *  而非 SquareTileFrame）。零行为新增：仅包装私有 tileFrameGen。 */
export function genTileFrame(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number): void {
  const ctx: SweepCtx = { rng, destroyObject: false, frameSparse: false, stats: undefined };
  tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x, y, true);
}

const roll3 = (ctx: SweepCtx): number => {
  if (ctx.stats) ctx.stats.roll184++;
  return ctx.rng ? ctx.rng.int(0, 2) : 0;
};
const rollRange = (ctx: SweepCtx, min: number, maxIncl: number): number => {
  if (ctx.stats) ctx.stats.rollsOther++;
  return ctx.rng ? ctx.rng.int(min, maxIncl) : min;
};

/** TileFrame 生成期（cs:82067） */
function tileFrameGen(st: TileStore, ctx: SweepCtx, x: number, y: number, reset: boolean): void {
  // 边距 5 早退（cs:82070）；!active 清 half/slope/块漆早退（cs:82078-82082，
  // ClearBlockPaintAndCoating——RRRR 补块漆清）
  if (x <= 5 || y <= 5 || x >= st.w - 5 || y >= st.h - 5) return;
  const i = st.idx(x, y);
  if (!st.flags[i]) { st.half[i] = 0; st.slope[i] = 0; st.paint[i] = 0; return; }
  const sheet = SWEEP_SHEET[st.type[i]];
  if (sheet < 0) return;
  if (frameImportantDispatch(st, ctx, x, y, sheet, reset)) return;
  // 非实心非 frameImportant：仙人掌 / 藤（cs:82102-82117）
  const d = TILE_DEFS[st.type[i]];
  if (!d?.solid) {
    if (sheet === 80) { if (checkCactusSweep(st, ctx, x, y)) return; }
    else if (IS_VINE.has(sheet)) { checkVinesSweep(st, ctx, x, y, sheet); return; }
  }
}

  /** C# NextDouble()（:113-115）*/
  nextDouble(): number {

  /** C# Peek()（:88-99，非消耗）：下一 InternalSample 原始差值——对账/断点用 */
  peek(): number {
    let num = this.inext + 1;
    if (num > 55) num = 1;
    let num2 = num + 21;
    if (num2 > 55) num2 -= 55;
    return this.seedArray[num] - this.seedArray[num2];
  }

}

/** SolidTileAllowBottomSlope（WorldGen.cs）：active && (tileSolid||tileSolidTop) && !half && 非顶坡 */
function supportOk(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): boolean {
  if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return true;              // 界外恒 true（原版 InWorld 早退）
  const i = st.idx(x, y);
  if (st.flags[i] === 0) return false;
  if (!vanGenSolidType(st.type[i]) && !HOUSE_SOLID_TOP.has(TILE_DEFS[st.type[i]]?.vanilla?.sheet ?? -1)) return false;
  if (st.half[i] !== 0) return false;
  if (st.slope[i] === 1 || st.slope[i] === 2) return false;  // 顶坡（平台正规顶帧例外略——房内地板无此形态）
  return true;
}

-1)) return false;\n  if (st.half[i] !== 0) return false;\n  if (st.slope[i] === 1 || st.slope[i] === 2) return false;   // 顶坡（平台正规顶帧例外略）\n  return true;\n}\nfunction checkOrbKF(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number): void {\n  if (!st.inBounds(x, y) || orbGuard) return;\n  const i = st.idx(x, y);\n  if (!st.flags[i]) return;\n  const sheet = TILE_DEFS[st.type[i]]?.vanilla?.sheet ?? -1) === sheet) {\n        killTileChest(st, rng, m, n);               // 尘掷走表 + 引擎九宫级联（雕像等）\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  orbGuard = false;\n}\n/** KillTile 尾 SquareTileFrame 九宫的 orb 派发补扫（引擎已分派族由 killTileChest 内\n *  genSquareTileFrame 承担；此处只补 orb 族——序沿引擎九宫列主序）。 */\nfunction killTileChestKF(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number): void {\n  killTileChest(st, rng, x, y);\n  for (const [dx, dy] of [[-1, -1], [-1, 0], [-1, 1], [0, -1], [0, 0], [0, 1], [1, -1], [1, 0], [1, 1]] as const) {\n    checkOrbKF(st, rng, x + dx, y + dy);\n  }\n}\n\nexport function runJungleChestsPass(\n  st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink, spots: Array<{ x: number; y: number }>,\n): void {\n  for (const s of spots) {\n    const main = nextJungleItem(gs, rng);\n    if (!placeBuriedChest(st, rng, gs, chests, s.x + rng.int(0, 1), s.y, { style: 10, loot: main, flags: { ivy: true } })) {\n      // ★OOOOO：回退清场 = vanilla KillTile（cs:17320-23）——尘掷 + SquareTileFrame 级联\n      //   （多格件越框残部整组杀：s22222 (3214-3215,485-487) 雕像 2×3 六格全灭 / 心 2×2）。\n      //   曾 setTileSilent(0) 裸清 3×3：框外残格存活 → 二次放置箱体撞残件被拒\n      //   （s22222 #61 首 19 格残带主体：E 神龛 (3216,484) 双试全败 + 心/雕像孤儿格）。\n      for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {\n        for (let dy = 0; dy <= 2; dy++) {\n          if (st.inBounds(s.x + dx, s.y + dy)) killTileChestKF(st, rng, s.x + dx, s.y + dy);\n        }\n      }\n      // ★J3(cs:17324-17332):第二次放置前对 3×4(含地面行 y+3)统一 slope(0)/halfBrick(false)\n      //   ——落地行残留半砖/坡面会顶掉第二次 AddBuriedChest。\n      for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {\n        for (let dy = 0; dy <= 3; dy++) {\n          if (!st.inBounds(s.x + dx, s.y + dy)) continue;\n          const i = st.idx(s.x + dx, s.y + dy);\n          st.slope[i] = 0; st.half[i] = 0;\n        }\n      }\n      placeBuriedChest(st, rng, gs, chests, s.x, s.y, { style: 10, loot: main, flags: { ivy: true } });\n    }\n  }\n}"

function sheetId(sheet: number): number {
  for (let id = 0; id < TILE_DEFS.length; id++) {
    const d = TILE_DEFS[id];
    if (d && d.vanilla?.sheet === sheet && d.key.startsWith('v_')) return id;
  }
  return -1;
}

function countTile(world: World, type: number): number {
  const st = world.store;
  let n = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < st.type.length; i++) {
    if (st.flags[i] && st.type[i] === type) n++;
  }
  return n;
}

function countWall(world: World, wall: number): number {
  const st = world.store;
  let n = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < st.wall.length; i++) if (st.wall[i] === wall) n++;
  return n;
}

// generateWorld 终态 type/flags/wall/liquid 的 FNV-1a 硬断言——从此任何
// 管线 pass 的无意改动(漏掷骰/改常量/换顺序)都会被确定性抓住,而非等用户
// 肉眼发现「悬空宝石」式的生成期 bug。
//
// 基线再生(有意改动 worldgen 后):
//   UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 npx vitest run tests/world-final-hash.test.ts
// 提交前必须人工确认改动本身是原版 1:1(金标只锁"没变",不锁"对不对")。
// 注意:与 caves-checkpoint 的 C# 位级金标互补——那套锁到 underworld 且逐段,
// 本门锁全管线终态(含 corruption 之后的全部 pass)。
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, existsSync, mkdirSync } from 'fs';
import { join } from 'path';
import { generateWorld } from '../src/world/gen/WorldGen';
import { fnv1a } from './pass-hash.test';

const GOLDEN_DIR = join(__dirname, 'golden');
const CASES = [
  { seed: '9293480', evil: 0, file: 'world-final-9293480.json' },
  { seed: '1511931452', evil: 1, file: 'world-final-1511931452.json' },
];

describe('终态哈希金标门(全管线)', () => {
  for (const c of CASES) {
    it(`种子 ${c.seed}:generateWorld 终态四数组哈希恒定`, async () => {
      const world = await generateWorld({ width: 4200, height: 1200, seedText: c.seed, evil: c.evil as 0 | 1 });
      const st = world.store;
      const hashes = {
        type: fnv1a(st.type), flags: fnv1a(st.flags),
        wall: fnv1a(st.wall), liquid: fnv1a(st.liquid),
      };
      const path = join(GOLDEN_DIR, c.file);
      if (process.env.UPDATE_GOLDEN === '1') {
        if (!existsSync(GOLDEN_DIR)) mkdirSync(GOLDEN_DIR);
        writeFileSync(path, JSON.stringify({ seed: c.seed, ...hashes }, null, 2));
        console.log(`[world-final-hash] 再生 ${path}`, hashes);
        return;
      }
      expect(existsSync(path), `金标缺失 ${c.file}(先 UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 再生)`).toBe(true);
      const golden = JSON.parse(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')) as Record<string, string>;
      expect(hashes.type).toBe(golden.type);
      expect(hashes.flags).toBe(golden.flags);
      expect(hashes.wall).toBe(golden.wall);
      expect(hashes.liquid).toBe(golden.liquid);
    }, 300000);
  }
});
